entries.title: Ezekiel 27:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:2
segments: "Now, son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre,

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:3
segments: "and say to Tyre, 'You who are situated at the entrance of the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coastlands, thus says the Lord GOD: "O Tyre, you have said, 'I [am] perfect in beauty.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:4
segments: Your borders [are] in the midst of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:5
segments: They made all [your] planks of fir trees from Senir; They took a cedar from Lebanon to make you a mast.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:6
segments: [Of] oaks from Bashan they made your oars; The company of Ashurites have inlaid your planks [With] ivory from the coasts of Cyprus.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:7
segments: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was what you spread for your sail; Blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah was what covered you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:8
segments: "Inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; Your wise men, O Tyre, were in you; They became your pilots.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:9
segments: Elders of Gebal and its wise men Were in you to caulk your seams; All the ships of the sea And their oarsmen were in you To market your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:10
segments: "Those from Persia, Lydia, and Libya Were in your army as men of war; They hung shield and helmet in you; They gave splendor to you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:11
segments: Men of Arvad with your army [were] on your walls [all] around, And the men of Gammad were in your towers; They hung their shields on your walls [all] around; They made your beauty perfect.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:12
segments: "Tarshish [was] your merchant because of your many luxury goods. They gave you silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:13
segments: "Javan, Tubal, and Meshech [were] your traders. They bartered human lives and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:14
segments: "Those from the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, steeds, and mules.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:15
segments: "The men of Dedan [were] your traders; many isles [were] the market of your hand. They brought you ivory tusks and ebony as payment.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:16
segments: "Syria [was] your merchant because of the abundance of goods you made. They gave you for your wares emeralds, purple, embroidery, fine linen, corals, and rubies.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:17
segments: "Judah and the land of Israel [were] your traders. They traded for your merchandise wheat of Minnith, millet, honey, oil, and balm.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:18
segments: "Damascus [was] your merchant because of the abundance of goods you made, because of your many luxury items, with the wine of Helbon and with white wool.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:19
segments: "Dan and Javan paid for your wares, traversing back and forth. Wrought iron, cassia, and cane were among your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:20
segments: "Dedan [was] your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:21
segments: "Arabia and all the princes of Kedar [were] your regular merchants. They traded with you in lambs, rams, and goats.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:22
segments: "The merchants of Sheba and Raamah [were] your merchants. They traded for your wares the choicest spices, all kinds of precious stones, and gold.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:23
segments: "Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Assyria, [and] Chilmad [were] your merchants.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:24
segments: "These [were] your merchants in choice items-in purple clothes, in embroidered garments, in chests of multicolored apparel, in sturdy woven cords, which were in your marketplace.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:25
segments: "The ships of Tarshish were carriers of your merchandise. You were filled and very glorious in the midst of the seas.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:26
segments: ¶Your oarsmen brought you into many waters, But the east wind broke you in the midst of the seas.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:27
segments: "Your riches, wares, and merchandise, Your mariners and pilots, Your caulkers and merchandisers, All your men of war who [are] in you, And the entire company which [is] in your midst, Will fall into the midst of the seas on the day of your ruin.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:28
segments: The common-land will shake at the sound of the cry of your pilots.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:29
segments: "All who handle the oar, The mariners, All the pilots of the sea Will come down from their ships [and] stand on the shore.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:30
segments: They will make their voice heard because of you; They will cry bitterly and cast dust on their heads; They will roll about in ashes;

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:31
segments: They will shave themselves completely bald because of you, Gird themselves with sackcloth, And weep for you With bitterness of heart [and] bitter wailing.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:32
segments: In their wailing for you They will take up a lamentation, And lament for you: 'What [city is] like Tyre, Destroyed in the midst of the sea?

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:33
segments: 'When your wares went out by sea, You satisfied many people; You enriched the kings of the earth With your many luxury goods and your merchandise.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:34
segments: But you are broken by the seas in the depths of the waters; Your merchandise and the entire company will fall in your midst.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:35
segments: All the inhabitants of the isles will be astonished at you; Their kings will be greatly afraid, And [their] countenance will be troubled.

entries.title: Ezekiel 27:36
segments: The merchants among the peoples will hiss at you; You will become a horror, and [be] no more forever.'"'"
